units.source_text: 源氏大将去后，这三条宫邸里几个老年宫女淌着眼泪赞扬他：“

en.t: After General Genji left, several elderly ladies-in-waiting at the Sanjo residence praised him through their tears:

units.source_text: 这位公子年龄越长，态度越是优美无比了。

en.t: The older this noble gentleman grows, the more incomparably graceful his manner becomes.

units.source_text: 当年权势鼎盛、万事如意称心之时，有天下惟我独尊的气概。

en.t: In those days, when his power was at its height and everything went exactly as he wished, he had the air of one who alone stood supreme under heaven.

units.source_text: 我等正在猜量：这样的人，何由悟得世故人情呢？

en.t: We used to wonder how such a person could ever come to understand the ways of the world and the feelings of others.

units.source_text: 岂知现在竟已变得十分温良恭谨，即使对付些些小事，也都体贴入微，郑重其事。

en.t: Who would have thought that now he would become so gentle, kind, respectful, and careful, attending even to the smallest matters with delicate consideration and real seriousness.

units.source_text: 教人看了不知不觉地怜惜他呢。”

en.t: Watching him, one cannot help but feel tender pity for him without even realizing it.

units.source_text: 藤壶皇后听了这话，不禁回想起种种往事来。

en.t: When Empress Fujitsubo heard these words, she could not help recalling all kinds of things from the past.
